title: AIchemist Desktop Buddy sprite pack
description: pack.json of a sprite pack. See docs/sprite-pack.md. Rules the schema cannot express (durations length = frames, durations only in format 2, image size) are checked by tools/check-sprites.mjs.

format.description: Pack format version: 1, or 2 (adds per-frame durations). Format 1 packs stay valid.

license.description: License of the art, ideally an SPDX identifier such as MIT or CC-BY-4.0.

frameSize.description: Size of one frame in pixels. All states share it.

file.description: PNG file name in the pack folder (no directories). Frames are laid out left to right in one row.

frames.description: Number of frames in the strip.

fps.description: Playback rate. 0 means a static frame (only frame 0 is shown). Ignored when durations is given.

durations.description: Format 2 only. How long each frame is shown, in milliseconds, one entry per frame (length = frames). Replaces fps when present.

loop.description: true: repeat. false: play once and hold the last frame.
